verdict.rationale: Azure documents several programmatic routes for managing resources: REST APIs secured through Entra ID with client libraries for most services, a cross-platform CLI for interactive or scripted management, and declarative IaC through ARM templates, Bicep and Terraform. A hands-on user reports that "almost everything can be done via command line." missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that portal and API capabilities are at parity, and independent confirmation that no portal-only features exist (the community quote says "almost").
